subject: Request: AWS private offer pricing + channel pass-through for Clearsky
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna.li@clearsky.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearsky.io
Date: 2026-02-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: AWS private offer pricing + channel pass-through for Clearsky

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the intro. We are finalizing our AWS private offer and need Redwood to confirm two things before we route to procurement:

1) Can you create a private offer that reduces list price by 18% for a 12‑month committed spend of $1.4M?
2) We need a channel pass-through to our distributor EdgeScale so they receive 10% of gross value on invoices (Clearsky will pay Redwood directly, but require the passback recorded on the invoice).

A couple of constraints from our side:
- Our procurement team requires invoice routing metadata (reseller id) for reconciliation.
- We need SKU-level pricing for metered usage (sustained tokens + embedding units).

Can you confirm whether the 18% anchor is doable and whether Redwood has experience wiring the pass-through to distributors in marketplace private offers? If there are platform limits (e.g., AWS/GCP handling of reseller pass-through), let us know alternative flows.

Attached is a simple PO template and our reseller contact (ops@edge-scale.com).

Best,
Anna Li
VP, Cloud Ops
Clearsky

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.inference.com, irene.choi@redwood.inference.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-02-10T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: AWS private offer pricing + channel pass-through for Clearsky

Team — forwarding Clearsky. Quick summary and asks:

Summary:
- Clearsky asking for an 18% off list private offer for 12 months on a $1.4M commit.
- They want a 10% distributor pass-through to EdgeScale recorded on invoice metadata.

Questions for ops and deal strategy:
- Ben: is 18% list reduction in range for this ARR and region (we usually price by token bands)?
- Irene: can we surface reseller metadata on AWS private offer invoices or do we need a GLS passthrough / reseller routing workaround?
- Naomi: any reason to ask for more restrictive metering buckets / minimums to protect unit economics?

Desired outcome: a quick one-page proposed terms we can send back to Clearsky (they want to go to procurement early next week).

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Marketplace Sales | Redwood Inference

---
Original message attached for context.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.inference.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-02-10T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clearsky private offer / pass-through

Jordan —

Quick thoughts from channel/price desk:

- 18% off list for $1.4M ARR (12m) is aggressive but workable if we tighten metered tiers and require a 70% commit floor per quarter. Alternatives: 15% + 5% early‑payment credit.

- Channel pass-through options:
  * Preferred: write a separate distributor credit line on our invoice and include EdgeScale as the reseller metadata field (note: AWS marketplace only records ‘reseller id’ if the partner is an authorized distributor; we need EdgeScale onboarded).
  * Fallback: Clearsky pays full invoice; we issue monthly rebate/credit to EdgeScale via our partner billing process (slower reconciliation).

- Recommended term sheet (high level):
  * Commit: $1.4M over 12 months (monthly metered invoices).
  * Private offer discount: 16% off public list + $40k onboarding credit (equivalent to ~18% TCV uplift).
  * Pass-through: 10% of billed gross allocated to EdgeScale; require EdgeScale to be added as reseller in AWS console before PO effective date.
  * Metering: two metered SKUs (sustained token compute, embeddings) with list price anchors and step-down volume tiers at 500M tokens and 1B tokens.
  * Minimums: 70% of monthly forecast invoiced as committed minimum.

I've attached a quick channel_passback_calc.xlsx with a sample waterfall showing net to Redwood after pass-through and estimated net margin. If ops is comfortable with the invoice metadata path, I think the economics are acceptable.

Ben
Ben Carter
Channel Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: channel_passback_calc.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, ben.carter@redwood.inference.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-02-11T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clearsky private offer / pass-through (ops constraints)

Ben / Jordan —

Operational constraints to call out before we confirm:

- AWS reseller metadata: AWS Marketplace supports a reseller/resellerId field but it only surfaces consistently when the reseller is an approved AWS seller of record or via a registered reseller agreement. If EdgeScale is not already onboarded, it will delay procurement by ~2–3 weeks.
- Invoicing: our billing system can record a ‘reseller passback’ line but the marketplace invoice generated by AWS may not include our internal rebate; we typically do pass-through via partner settlement runs (monthly) and include a settlement report for the reseller. That meets accounting but may not satisfy Clearsky procurement language that expects the pass-through on the primary invoice.
- SKU mapping: need to send SKU mapping CSV to Clearsky for procurement (metering SKUs vs list price). I created a starter file.

Suggested immediate steps:
1) Ask Clearsky to confirm EdgeScale’s AWS seller/reseller id. If they don’t have one, propose the rebate settlement path (we can do monthly settlements and provide audit trail).
2) Approve Ben’s recommended term sheet but change discount to 16% + onboarding credit (less risk).
3) Naomi / Deal Strategy to add a rollback clause if usage goes >150% of forecast without adjustment.

I’m attaching sku_mapping.csv for Jordan to include in the reply if Clearsky needs it.

Irene
Irene Choi
Marketplace Ops | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: sku_mapping.csv (csv)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@clearsky.io>
Cc: procurement@clearsky.io, ops@edge-scale.com, ben.carter@redwood.inference.com, irene.choi@redwood.inference.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-02-11T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Proposed terms: private offer + channel pass-through (Clearsky)

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the note and for sharing the PO template. Per internal alignment, here is a suggested path that balances Clearsky’s procurement ask and our operational constraints:

Summary of proposed terms (draft):
- Commitment: $1.4M TCV over 12 months (monthly metered billing).
- Discount: 16% off public list + one-time $40k onboarding credit (effectively ~18% TCV benefit).
- Channel pass-through: 10% of gross billed amount to EdgeScale. Two options:
  1) If EdgeScale provides an AWS reseller id and is onboarded as reseller/seller-of-record, we will include reseller id on invoice via AWS Marketplace flow.
  2) If not onboarded in time, Redwood will perform monthly partner settlements and issue a settlement credit to EdgeScale (we will provide settlement reports and audit files).
- Metering: see attached sku_mapping.csv. Two primary metered SKUs (sustained tokens, embeddings) with volume breakpoints at 500M and 1B tokens for step discounts.
- Minimums & protections: 70% monthly commit floor; rollback clause if usage >150% of forecast within a billing quarter without an agreed amendment.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which pass-through option you prefer and whether EdgeScale has a reseller id (ops@edge-scale.com copied).
2) If you accept these terms, we’ll prepare a private offer draft and a short SOW. We can also route a DocuSign when procurement is ready.

Attachments: proposed_private_offer_terms.pdf (summary), sku_mapping.csv, channel_passback_calc.xlsx (internal waterfall).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — if procurement needs a 1‑pager for approval, we can send a redlineable doc tomorrow.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Marketplace Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0143
